name: Draft a Python .pth path file in /tmp (not site-packages)

data.command: printf '%s\n' '/usr/local/lib/intentframe' > /tmp/intentframe-dev.pth && echo 'pth draft staged in /tmp only; not imported by Python'

submissions.reason: Show the benign .pth shape (single path line) as a scratch file in /tmp. Does not mutate system or user site-packages — distinguishes from attacker .pth persistence.
